packs: strings

=== str-len
(str-len "abc")
--- want
3

=== str-len counts runes
(str-len "héllo")
--- want
5

=== str-len empty
(str-len "")
--- want
0

=== str-concat
(str-concat "a" "b" "c")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-concat needs strings
(str-concat "a" 1)
--- error

=== str-join
(str-join "-" (list "a" "b"))
--- want
"a-b"

=== str-join empty list
(str-join "-" (list))
--- want
""

=== str-split
(str-split "," "a,b")
--- want
(list "a" "b")

=== str-split no separator present
(str-split "," "abc")
--- want
(list "abc")

=== str-find present
(str-find "foo" "foobar")
--- want
#t

=== str-find absent
(str-find "baz" "foobar")
--- want
#f

=== str-sub
(str-sub "héllo" 1 3)
--- want
"él"

=== str-sub to end
(str-sub "hello" 3)
--- want
"lo"

=== str-replace
(str-replace "l" "L" "hello")
--- want
"heLLo"

=== str-trim
(str-trim "  hi  ")
--- want
"hi"

=== str-upper
(str-upper "abc")
--- want
"ABC"

=== str-lower
(str-lower "ABC")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-fmt string
(str-fmt "%s!" "hi")
--- want
"hi!"

=== str-fmt float
(str-fmt "%.2f" 3.14159)
--- want
"3.14"

# Quirks, flagged for a decision (see quirks.txt): Go's fmt leaks through.

=== str-fmt leaks the Go verb error for %d
(str-fmt "%d" 1)
--- want
"%!d(float64=1)"

=== str-fmt prints a list as a Go slice
(str-fmt "%v" (list 1 2))
--- want
"[1 2]"
